implemented: Social header now uses three prismatic switchers: Nexus mode, feed source, and friends relations.
Feed switcher includes For You, Local Trends, Global Trends, Friends, Following, Private Content, and Breaking.
Friends switcher exposes Followers, Following, and Favorite, with device-local star favorites for the demo.
Feed photos and clips open a full-screen media viewer with reaction tray, comments panel, save, share, support, report, arrows, and swipe gestures.
Opening media records a local Social impression; images are marked completed on open, while explicit reactions remain separate actions.
Private profile paywall settings were added to persona schema/API/UI: enabled, price, currency, duration days, default 15 USD for 30 days.
Private Content feed screen shows anonymous timed access, 90 percent creator / 10 percent Nexus split, and no real payment execution in demo.

verification.node_path: node.exe and npm.cmd were not available in the PowerShell PATH for direct node --test execution.

limitations: The running server process may need a safe restart before newly added backend routes and schema migrations are loaded by that process.
No real payment, stablecoin settlement, xMoney execution, production escrow, or mainnet transaction was performed.
Favorite friends are demo-local on the current device until a cross-device private graph model is approved and implemented.
The private unlock receipt model is represented in UI/API settings only; privacy-preserving settlement remains a later bounded packet.
